events.summary: SystemA new “Dodge on Release” option has been added to the game settings. When enabled, sprinting is performed by holding the dodge button, while dodging is triggered by quickly pressing and releasing it.

SystemThe current quick slot can no longer be switched to a quick slot with no item assigned.A gameplay tip for the Quick Use button will now be displayed during gameplay.Bug FixesFixed a bug that prevented attacks from hitting overlapping enemies simultaneously.Fixed a bug where the inventory was displayed below the transition effect while moving between areas.

Balance & Bug FixesIncreased the delay between throwing a bomb and the Mine Slave's follow-up action when the player is within its detection range.
